input_ref: Pharmacy advocate: Can I talk about the drug and the price when a caregiver has no authorization on the account?

output.reason: This unit fully answers the question: caregivers must have an authorization on the account before any drug or price discussion, so without one the answer is no. U-RX-EDU-001-05 only says to check the authorization, not what to do when it is missing. U-WEB-FAQ-01 is about price estimates and does not apply.
